beliefs.belief: Didn't hesitate in the tunnels. Doesn't mean he listens.
He listened. Then he asked the right question first. That's twice he hasn't hesitated.
Said it was my protocol and he'd stand behind it. Most officers say that and then present it.

recent: called the XO for ten minutes on intruder response
gave the XO her incident log and the eleven names
the XO's design: silent alert, thirty seconds, then yellow; one word stands it down
the XO and she carry the alert protocol in together, hers; internal sensors never logged Q
La Forge saw Q through the VISOR: even heat, no pulse
